mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ref_order(sn, source, group_id, submitter_id, submitter_name, project_group_name, project_group_id, aup_record_id, register_no, campus, aro_area_name, status, submit_remark, submitted_at, estimated_delivery_date) VALUES (#{sn}, COALESCE(#{source}, 'LOCAL'), #{groupId}, #{submitterId}, #{submitterName}, #{projectGroupName}, #{projectGroupId}, #{aupRecordId}, #{registerNo}, #{campus}, #{aroAreaName}, #{status}, #{submitRemark}, #{submittedAt}, #{estimatedDeliveryDate})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ref_order WHERE source = #{source} AND sn = #{sn} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ref_order SET project_group_name = #{projectGroupName}, project_group_id = #{projectGroupId}, submitter_id = #{submitterId}, submitter_name = #{submitterName}, campus = #{campus}, aro_area_name = #{aroAreaName}, status = #{status}, submitted_at = #{submittedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ref_order WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM ref_order WHERE group_id = #{groupId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ref_order WHERE status = #{status}
